# Code of conduct

SISF adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/), by reference. It applies in the repository, its issues, pull requests and discussions, and wherever someone represents the project.

## Reporting

A dedicated contact for conduct reports has not been named yet. Until it is, report abusive content to GitHub with the "Report content" option in the menu of the comment, issue or pull request. Do not use the security reporting route for conduct reports.
